levels.surface: محمد بن الحسن بن أحمد بن الوليد

notes: «4 -» is the report number; «رحمه الله» is not part of the name; «ويعقوب بن يزيد» is a co-transmitter of «إبراهيم بن هاشم» in one level; the Imam is written inside the chain after «عن», so he stays narrator; the Quranic phrase after «في قوله عز وجل» is the topic and the Imam's explanation is the saying
